name: Product Hunt MCP
tagline: The community you trust in the assistant you use
description: Ask your AI assistant to find your next favorite product. Explore new launches, compare alternatives, and see what the Product Hunt community thinks. Building something yourself? Turn your README and website into a launch draft, add images, and check what's missing before you submit. Sign in with Product Hunt to connect. No API key needed.

name: Dageno AI 2.0
tagline: See why AI recommends your competitors instead of you
description: AI is now choosing brands for your customers. Dageno AI is an AEO/GEO platform that shows whether ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and 7 more AI models recommend you or your competitors, and which sources drive those answers. Look up any market for free, forever: see top brands, buyer questions and cited sources across 12,000+ niche markets and 3M+ brands. Upgrade only when you need to track your own prompts. Built for brands and agencies.

name: Databox CLI
tagline: Your agentic analytics platform in the terminal
description: Create data sources, load data, build metrics, and automate workflows directly from your terminal. Use 90+ commands yourself, or let AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex do the work with 10 ready-to-use agent skills.

name: Arcjet AI security models
tagline: A family of custom-trained security models for coding agents
description: Arcjet is launching a family of custom AI security models designed for analyzing AI agent activity: Arcjet Himalia 1, a general purpose prompt injection model, live today for every SDK call that uses prompt injection detection, and specialist versions designed for situations that general models handle badly, Arcjet Thebe 1 for coding agents, and Arcjet Carme 1, for autonomous security agents.

name: Voyager
tagline: ✴️ An agentic file browser to navigate your work context
description: Voyager brings AI agents into your everyday file work on macOS. Find the files you need and work with AI agents using them as context, all within a familiar file browser. Meet a file browser built for finding your files and putting them to work with AI.

name: ProtoMap
tagline: Stop wasting AI tokens rediscovering dependencies
description: ProtoMap helps engineers and AI coding agents understand how services, APIs, and data fields depend on each other across large codebases. It builds a deterministic dependency map for gRPC and Protobuf systems, updated on every commit and accessible through a web app or MCP. Instead of wasting time and tokens searching code across repositories, agents query ProtoMap directly to understand change impact. One enterprise team reduced change-planning time and tokens by 8×.

name: MCP1
tagline: One URL for every MCP server.
description: Connect and manage all your MCP servers through a single gateway. Built by Appwrite, MCP1 lets you securely connect your AI tools, manage permissions, protect server credentials, and monitor tool usage. Works with Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, Codex, and more. Free for individuals, with dedicated plans for teams and enterprises.

name: Higgsfield Miracle
tagline: Edit any part of a video without changing the rest
description: Higgsfield Miracle vectorizes any video into layers for localized, pixel-level editing in real time, with world knowledge built in. Recolor objects, change backgrounds, remove or add elements, adjust lighting, and modify textures while preserving the original motion, camera, and subjects.

name: GitHub New PR Overview
tagline: See what's blocking a PR before you scroll
description: GitHub's new pull request overview page moves merge status to the top, with checks, approvals, comments, and next actions in one compact summary. It also adds unresolved-comment filters, newest-first sorting, and an activity panel.

name: Cardboard AI
tagline: Best way to edit videos with AI
description: Cardboard is an AI video editor that turns your raw clips into stories. Think of it as a creative collaborator that understands your footage, has taste to know what makes a great edit, and brings your vision to life.

name: Pawse.ai
tagline: Sound engineered for dogs, not humans
description: Pawse.ai writes sound for your dog while it plays. Every session is shaped to how dogs hear. Choose Sleep, Home Alone, Loud Noise, Travel or Vet Visit. Tell it what your dog did and the next session adjusts. The Apple TV app keeps playing after you leave.

name: Jotform App for Shopify
tagline: Build powerful forms for your Shopify store
description: Bring Jotform’s powerful forms to your Shopify store. Create contact forms, lead forms, applications, registrations, surveys, and more. Match your store’s style, add conditional logic, calculations, and file uploads, and connect responses to the tools your team uses. Manage forms and submissions in Jotform, with your store as another place to reach customers.

name: Egoist AI Passport
tagline: Secure and share your personal data with AI tools.
description: AI Passport securely saves your personal data in one place, then lets you bring that context into the AI tools you use. Connect apps like Email, Calendar, ChatGPT, Claude, and more, choose exactly what data you want to share, and what you want to keep private, and revoke permissions whenever you want. Your AI tools get more personal, while your data stays yours.

name: KIKUmap
tagline: A mind map for your Claude and ChatGPT chats
description: A macOS menu-bar app and desktop widget: see which Claude and ChatGPT chats are running, done or waiting for you, and arrange them as a mind map. Free and open source.

name: If You Read This
tagline: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch
description: A daily check-in app that works like a dead man's switch. You check in by opening the app. If you miss your check-in and its reminders, your pre-written message is texted to the contacts you chose. For US and Canadian phone numbers.

name: Watchflows
tagline: Visual automation for your Mac, with AI built in
description: Stop doing the same Mac chores by hand. Watchflows runs them the moment something happens: a file lands in Downloads, you press a hotkey, a webhook arrives, it's 8:30 on a weekday. Wire triggers, conditions, actions and AI on a canvas, or describe it in plain English and the Flow Builder assembles it. AI reads, renames and decides mid-flow, on Watchflows AI, Apple's on-device model, Ollama, or your own keys. Local-first, no account. 14-day free trial, then $49 once. Also on Setapp.

name: ClipsPal
tagline: AI video editor that edits your talking-head videos
description: Desktop video editor for Mac and Windows. Drop in raw clips: ClipsPal cuts failed takes and silences, adds zoom-ins, subtitles, visuals and sound, then turns the video into shorts and articles. Runs on your Claude Code or Codex. Pay once, no subscription.

name: CozyZip
tagline: Zip and unzip without the surprises.
description: Preview, create and extract archives on your Mac, in Terminal or through local MCP tools. Free lifetime personal licence with verified email. Commercial use is US$5 once per person on up to three Macs. macOS 26+, Apple Silicon.

name: Sign Language by Panda Video
tagline: Add a sign language interpreter to videos already online
description: Upload a video of your sign language interpreter and link it to any video you've already published. Viewers turn the interpreter window on from the player, then move and resize it. Everyone else watches as usual. No re-editing, no re-uploading.

name: Terse - Durable Actors
tagline: Infrastructure for Multiplayer AI Products
description: We provide an army of tiny servers to help you build incredible and cost efficient Multiplayer AI at scale. It's an open source alternative to Cloudflare's Durable Objects. Each resource or agent gets it's own micro-vm with a co-located SQLite DB. It can only process one request at a time making it concurrency safe. Onboard each one, is a websocket server. Allowing clients of any form to connect and listen for events on the resource.
